meta.title: Multi-GSTIN-per-PAN Selection: refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Vendor role and verify Multi-GSTIN-per-PAN Selection is refused or absent.
Repeat the action as a Vendor and verify linked GSTINs are fetched with already-registered GSTINs greyed out.
Compare the authorization result between the two roles, including recording tenant RBAC configuration when additional roles are deliberately permitted.
